title: Source Ledger — Vesica, Mandorla, Sun, Moon, Mountain, Brain & Esoteric Comparisons
rule: Sources establish facts within their own domains. A source supporting Christian mandorla iconography does not support Potatoverse theology; a source documenting occult Moon symbolism does not validate astrology scientifically.
